title: Transparent Magnetic Wireless Charging Phone Case
description:
Protect your phone without hiding its original beauty.

Our Transparent Magnetic Wireless Charging Phone Case is crafted with a TPU + Acrylic hybrid build, offering a perfect balance of clarity, strength, and everyday protection.

✨ Clear & Premium Look

 

 

 

 

  • Crystal-clear acrylic back panel that showcases your phone’s original color
  • Resistant to yellowing for long-lasting transparency
  • Smooth, glossy finish for a modern premium feel

Durable TPU Protection

 

 

 

 

 

  • Flexible TPU bumper absorbs shocks and protects edges
  • Soft yet sturdy frame for comfortable grip
  • Raised edges around camera and screen for added safety

Magnetic Wireless Charging Compatible

 

 

 

 

 

  • Built-in magnetic ring ensures stable wireless charging
  • Compatible with magnetic chargers and accessories
  • No need to remove the case while charging

Perfect Fit & Easy Access

 

 

 

 

 

  • Precision cut-outs for camera, ports, and speakers
  • Responsive button covers for effortless use
  • Slim profile without adding bulk

Stylish Color Frames

 

 

 

 

• Available in trendy frame colors like Orange and Navy Blue, adding a bold outline to your clear case.

 

 

 Why Choose This Case?

 

 

✔ TPU + Acrylic hybrid material

 

✔ Transparent, non-frosted back

✔ Magnetic wireless charging support

✔ Camera & screen protection

✔ Lightweight and everyday-friendly

 

Package Includes

 

 

 

  • 1 × Transparent Magnetic Wireless Charging Phone Case

raw_html:
Protect your phone without compromising its iconic design. The Covertok Transparent Magnetic Case features an optical-grade acrylic backplate fused with an impact-absorbing TPU bumper, delivering military-grade drop defense while preserving your phone's authentic silhouette.

Design & Engineering

  • Optical-Grade Clarity: UV-stabilized acrylic backplate engineered to resist yellowing and retain crystal-clear transparency.
  • Hybrid Drop Defense: High-density shock-absorbing perimeter bumper protects edges against impacts and everyday drops.
  • Raised Perimeter Bezels: 1.2mm elevated lips shield camera lenses and front display from direct surface contact.

Charging & Ergonomics

  • Precision MagSafe Array: Embedded 38-magnet ring ensures instant snap-on alignment with fast wireless chargers and magnetic mounts.
  • Tactile Button Covers: Independently responsive button caps provide crisp, effortless tactile feedback.
  • Architectural Color Accent: Precision-molded contrast frame adds an intentional aesthetic outline to the transparent casing.

In The Box

  • 1 × Covertok Transparent Magnetic Case
  • 1 × Official 1-Year Quality Warranty Card
